title: The Scope and Nature of the U.S.-China Competition
summary_en: This is the first of several reports in a RAND study on the U.S.-China competition. The authors provide a framework for evaluating the character and status of that competition and give insight into how the United States can gain strategic leverage.
title_cn: The Scope and Nature of the U.S.-China Competition

title: Adversarial artificial intelligence: Implications of strategic stability attacks on military AI systems
summary_en: As military AI use grows, attacks that disrupt or deny AI systems could threaten strategic stability. This study examines risks to military and critical infrastructure systems, and recommends measures to reduce attacks and their impact globally.
title_cn: Adversarial artificial intelligence: Implications of strategic stability attacks on military AI systems
